japan-alpine-peaks-hidden-samurai-valley.lead: Japan’s Alpine heart: preserved Edo towns, thatched Shirakawa-go farmhouses and a private teahouse breakfast in Kenroku-en.

reasons.d: Wanosato Takayama is a luxury machiya estate in the heart of the preserved Edo-period town, with aged sake and Hida beef canapés on a private deck over the Miyagawa River at sunset.
Matsumoto’s five-storey black Crow Castle, and Shirakawa-go’s steep-roofed Gassho-zukuri farmhouses, built to withstand heavy mountain snow.
A private hot bento breakfast in a historic teahouse in Kenroku-en, one of Japan’s three great gardens, an after-hours walk through Myoryuji Ninja Temple, and the koi canals of Hida-Furukawa.

japan-ancient-spiritual-kingdom-sea-cana.lead: A night in a working Buddhist temple on Mount Koya, the Kumano Kodo pilgrimage trail and Naoshima’s art island, reached by private helicopter.

reasons.d: A night at Soji-in, a working Buddhist temple, with a traditional vegetarian meal and the monks’ pre-dawn chanting and fire rituals.
Okunoin, Japan’s largest sacred cemetery, walked beneath giant cedars past moss-covered stupas, then the stone stairways of the Kumano Kodo pilgrimage trail.
Private helicopters to Mount Koya and to Naoshima, then the Chichu Underground Museum, Benesse House, the Art House Project and a private yacht on the Seto Inland Sea.

malayan-grandeur.lead: Malaysia from the Petronas Towers to the Cameron Highlands’ tea hills, George Town’s street art and Langkawi’s sky bridge, in one flowing loop.

reasons.d: Three nights at the Grand Hyatt Kuala Lumpur with the Petronas skybridge and Batu Caves, then Crockfords Genting, the most private hotel in the Genting Highlands, with butler service.
Walks through the Cameron Highlands’ tea plantations and strawberry farms, and a private UNESCO tour of George Town’s shophouses, clan halls, street art and hawker food.
The Ritz-Carlton Langkawi’s beachfront rainforest setting, with the Langkawi Sky Bridge, island hopping and a mangrove safari.

malaysia-ancient-jungle-island-frontier.lead: Borneo in ten days: orangutans, sun bears and pygmy elephants, with a river villa and a canopy walkway in the Danum Valley rainforest.

reasons.d: Young orangutans learning to climb at the Sepilok Rehabilitation Centre, and the Sun Bear Conservation Centre, home to the world’s smallest bear.
A luxury river villa at Borneo Rainforest Lodge, with a private plunge pool suspended over the Danum River in untouched primary rainforest.
A dawn walk on the 300-metre canopy walkway, 26 metres above the forest floor, private tracking of Bornean pygmy elephants, and a champagne sunset beach below Mount Kinabalu.

malaysia-central-coral-coast-loop.lead: Kuala Lumpur’s skyline, then a private charter flight and yacht to Redang Island’s marine park for turtles and coral.

reasons.d: The double-decker Petronas Skybridge at 170 metres, the 272 steps up Batu Caves to a 42-metre golden statue, and a rooftop helipad sundowner over the skyline.
A private charter flight and luxury yacht to Redang Island, with world-class snorkelling among giant green sea turtles and reef walls.
The Setiu Wetlands’ crimson mangrove roots, lagoons and river terrapins, with a breakfast on an elevated wooden platform, then a cliffside spa at The Taaras.

malaysia-great-western-spice-route.lead: Penang’s heritage and Langkawi’s limestone coast, joined by a private speedboat across the sea.

reasons.d: The blue-washed Cheong Fatt Tze mansion, the stilted clan jetties with a botanical cocktail sundowner, and the ribbon bridge over a 130-million-year-old rainforest canopy on Penang Hill.
A private speedboat crossing from Penang to the Langkawi archipelago, avoiding the long way round.
A champagne brunch on an isolated sandbar in Kilim Karst Geoforest with brahminy kites overhead, the SkyBridge suspended 700 metres above sea level, and a yacht cruise along Datai Beach.

malaysia-southern-heritage-rainforest-ar.lead: Malacca’s Portuguese, Dutch and Peranakan layers, then a firefly safari and a jungle-cliff beach breakfast at One&Only Desaru Coast.

reasons.d: A Famosa fort, St Paul’s Church and the Dutch Christ Church square, a Malacca River cruise with vintage port and Nyonya delicacies, and the Baba & Nyonya Heritage Museum.
Dawn gibbon calls in Panti Forest Reserve, a bioluminescent firefly safari on the Lebam River, and the ancient rainforest of Endau-Rompin.
At One&Only Desaru Coast, a marine picnic with breakfast on an isolated jungle-cliff beach on a pristine South China Sea cove.

philippines-eastern-mindanao-siargao.lead: Siargao’s island circuit: a bare white sandbar, glowing caves and a lagoon of stingless jellyfish, from a clifftop villa.

reasons.d: The bare white sandbar of Naked Island, a champagne brunch in a private overwater reef pavilion on Daku Island, and snorkelling around circular Guyam atoll.
Swimming among millions of stingless neon-blue jellyfish in Sohoton Cove, water that glows blue in Hagukan Cave, and a 15-foot cliff jump in Magkukuob Cave.
A private pontoon sundowner on Sugba Lagoon’s glassy turquoise channels, then a night in a perched ocean villa at Nay Palad Hideaway.

philippines-northern-palawan-sanctuary.lead: El Nido’s hidden lagoons, private kayaks and a bioluminescent night swim, from the Pangulasian Island resort.

reasons.d: A swim through a tiny rock opening into the Secret Lagoon, a private kayak on the Big Lagoon past blue starfish and blacktip reef shark pups, and crowd-free snorkelling with sea turtles in Cadlao Lagoon.
A white-linen breakfast on Shimizu Island under a limestone overhang, and a sundowner on a deserted island with a carpet-and-pillow setup.
A bioluminescent swim among glowing plankton, plus a reef walk at Entalula and deep-wall snorkelling.

philippines-southern-luzon-calamianes.lead: Coron’s lakes, wrecks and dugongs: Asia’s clearest lake, a WWII shipwreck reef and sea cows, from a private-pool villa.

reasons.d: Kayangan Lake, famed for the cleanest water in Asia, Barracuda Lake’s thermocline where cool fresh water turns to 38°C salt, and the submerged rock tunnel at Twin Lagoons.
Exclusive snorkelling beside endangered dugongs at Busuanga, and the 25-metre WWII Japanese supply ship at Sangat Island, now a brain coral reef.

reasons.t: Powder sand and a lagoon sundowner
reasons.d: A sandbar breakfast on Malcapuya Island, a boat-deck sundowner of premium wine inside the limestone lagoon walls, and an island-tip pool villa at Two Seasons Coron.

singapore-couples-escape.lead: Singapore for two: a private dinner in a moving cable car, a tall-ship cruise and a skyline rooftop, with a full spa day.

reasons.d: A private multi-course dinner inside a moving cable car as the sun sets over Sentosa harbour.
A Royal Albatross tall-ship cruise with champagne and live music, sunset from Marina Bay Sands SkyPark with a rooftop dinner, and the lasers and fireworks of Wings of Time.
Six nights in the city at Hotel Mi Rochor and four at Shangri-La Rasa Sentosa, with a wellness day and walks through Chinatown, Little India and Haji Lane.

singapore-group-escape.lead: Singapore built for a group: a night safari, a private yacht, Universal Studios and an adrenaline day, with plenty of shared time.

reasons.d: Tram rides through illuminated jungle with nocturnal wildlife moving freely around you, plus the Singapore Zoo, Bird Paradise and River Wonders.
A private luxury yacht around the Southern Islands with music and cocktails at sunset, and Marina Bay Sands and the Merlion.
A full group day at Universal Studios Singapore, and an adrenaline day of Skyline Luge, Mega Zip and iFly indoor skydiving, with Sentosa’s beach clubs for downtime.
